# Wiktionary

> > A free multilingual dictionary providing comprehensive word definitions, etymologies, pronunciations, and grammatical information across languages including English, Latin, and others.

Wiktionary is a collaborative dictionary project that documents words, their forms, pronunciations (using the International Phonetic Alphabet), and grammatical variations. It covers multiple languages with detailed linguistic information including declensions, conjugations, and usage notes for both modern and classical languages.

## Key Topics

- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Latin grammar and declensions
- English verb forms and conjugations
- Classical Latin pronunciation
- General American English
- Received Pronunciation
- Dative and ablative cases
- Genitive singular forms
- Past tense and past participles
- Noun declensions
- Adjective forms
- Verb conjugations
- Etymology and word origins
- Phonetic transcription
- Grammatical inflection

## English Word Forms

- [started](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/started): English verb form: past tense/participle with pronunciation variants
- [street credibility](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/street_credibility): English uncountable noun: alternative form dictionary entry

## Latin Grammar and Declensions

- [pluribus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pluribus): Latin adjective form: dative/ablative plural declension with IPA
- [cruris](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cruris): Latin noun form: genitive singular declension entry
- [debere](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/debere): Latin verb forms: infinitive and imperative conjugations

## Optional

- [stigmatophilia](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/stigmatophilia): Paraphilia term: sexual arousal from body modification/piercings
